subject: IDS 2026 — Italy dealer compare v1.4 (map)
body:
Dear colleague,

Please find attached the IDS 2026 dealer compare pack for Italy (v1.4).

What is included
• Offline HTML: IDS_2026_dealer_compare_Italy.html
• Zip: IDS_2026_Italy_v1.4.zip
• Scope: Italy dealers only (41) — other countries are not visible
• UI: no Country filter / By country tab (single-market pack)
• Map tab: Leaflet pins; hover shows dealer total score vs the Italy national average (and the delta in percentage points)
• Network average charts still use the full IDS 2026 network as an anonymous benchmark (no other dealer names)

(IDS follow-up owner on 26 summary: Tomoe Baumann)

Open the HTML with an internet connection so map tiles can load.

Kind regards,
Jérôme Van der Pluym
